In both Corrugated and Consumer, we continue to see a reduction in loss makers and are optimizing our businesses to improve returns. Most importantly, I am particularly impressed with the expertise and commitment of our people that are leading the change towards a customer centric, performance-led culture. “Our EMEA & APAC business continues to outperform in a market that is heavily impacted by rising energy costs. The region reported Adjusted EBITDA of $379 million and an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 13.4% for the third quarter. Containerboard price increases to offset costs have been implemented and are being passed on with the normal time lag. Our EMEA & APAC business is increasingly seen as the partner of choice due to our unrivalled product portfolio and our leadership and investment in innovation, sustainability, quality and service. “In our Latin American region, during the third quarter, we announced our agreement to acquire the containerboard assets of CMPC in Chile. This acquisition further strengthens our leadership presence in Latin America as the only pan regional supplier, where we continue to see many opportunities for development. For the quarter, the region reported Adjusted EBITDA of $126 million and an Adjusted EBITDA margin of 21.4%. 1 Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA Margin and Adjusted Basic EPS are non-GAAP measures. See the “Non-GAAP Financial Measures and Reconciliations” below for discussion and reconciliation of these measures to the most comparable GAAP measures. 1 "For full year 2026, we now estimate our Adjusted EBITDA 2 to be approximately $4.7 billion. This expected outcome primarily reflects the continued and unprecedented cost inflation we are experiencing. For example, for the full year 2026 we expect to absorb approximately $700 million of additional freight and energy costs alone, significantly more than anticipated. We have, and are, implementing price increases to more than offset these costs, the full benefits of which we expect to realize into 2027. Against what has been a challenging operating environment I am very proud of the efforts of all our people who have set the foundation for continued progress into 2027 and beyond.” Dividend Smurfit Westrock plc announced today that its Board approved a quarterly dividend of $0.4523 per share on its ordinary shares.
